I've just pimped WINE for everything new directx and library tweaks for new(2015-2016) games. What would prevent me from using wine as a win10.gov sandbox?

It's not very effective, any program running in wine can modify your Linux filesystem (with the permissions of the running user). To make it more effective you could create a new user with minimal filesystem access permissions and run wine only on that account.
You just moved to the head of the class. I never run an admin only os. Does my running new directx dlls open me to attacks, despite wine having no internet permissions?

There is no such thing as "wine not having internet permissions". In theory, sure, you could remove the network stack in wine, but then it becomes basically useless, especially when online stores are the norm.
